versions.content: Name Icu_ Mode Type Kind Enumeration Range ICU_ MODE_ NORMAL -- Normal operation, all used interrupts are enabled according to the notification requests. ICU_ MODE_ SLEEP -- Reduced power operation. In sleep mode only those notifications are available which are configured as wakeup capable. Description Allow enabling / disabling of all interrupts which are not required for the ECU wakeup. Available via Icu.h
